daily.title: Germany's Isar rocket launches from arctic Norway and reaches orbit
daily.summary: Germany's Isar Aerospace launches a rocket into orbit from Norway as Europe races to boost its ability to send satellites into space.

daily.title: Meet the Rural Women's Award finalists for 2026
daily.summary: Australia's Rural Woman of the Year will be announced in Canberra on Tuesday, September 8.

daily.title: Hawkesbury's Helping Hands charity marks 15 years of service
daily.summary: What began as a mother and daughter providing some home-cooked meals in plastic containers has grown into a charity with a warehouse that provides hampers and basic essentials for hundreds of people across Sydney's most disaster-prone region.

daily.title: Perth looks back to the day when Mundaring Weir last overflowed
daily.summary: Thirty years ago, Perth's Mundaring Weir overflowed following good winter rains. The visitors who flocked to see the spectacle had no idea it would never happen again.

daily.title: Social media platforms to be forced to offer algorithm opt-out
daily.summary: Social media companies would be required to give users a choice to turn off their algorithm through pop-up messages, under draft laws to be unveiled by the government later this week.

daily.title: Indigenous dads challenging stereotypes this Father's Day
daily.summary: Indigenous fathers say damaging stereotypes continue to shape how they are seen as parents, as advocates call for their strengths and contributions to families to be celebrated this Father's Day.

daily.title: 'Illuminated temple' lost to fire was a remnant of Tasmania's hydro boom
daily.summary: Unless you have a connection to Hydro Tasmania, there is a good chance that this week was the first time you had ever heard of Tungatinah Power Station. The hydro-electric power station was destroyed by a fire on Wednesday night — with the cause of the blaze unknown.

daily.title: It doesn't look dangerous, but this sneaky snail causes enormous damage
daily.summary: The Drupella snail doesn't look threatening, but it is such a danger to Queensland's reefs that tourism operators have helped cull hundreds of thousands of them as part of a management plan.

daily.title: The ACT's 99-year leases are expiring — what does that mean for home owners?
daily.summary: The ACT is the only jurisdiction in Australia that operates under a leasehold system, meaning every home owner is actually a lessor. With the first of those leases coming up for renewal, there are questions about the leasing system's origin and ongoing relevance.

daily.title: The 100 Project preserves history of Australia's centenarians
daily.summary: Bek Hyland says her late 106-year-old grandma, Merle Moore, was incredibly grateful to the project for helping to preserve the story of her life.

daily.title: Calls to preserve largest Australian World War II prison camp
daily.summary: The camp housed Italian, German and Japanese prisoners between 1941 and 1947 and a portion of the former site is now on the market.

daily.title: Proposal to pump 70m litres of treated wastewater into Parramatta River
daily.summary: If approved, a Sydney facility will pump millions of litres of treated wastewater, equivalent to 35 Olympic-sized swimming pools, into Parramatta River per day to service a growing population.

daily.title: 'Conservative Catholic mafia': Inside the Liberal faction before ICAC
daily.summary: Take a look inside the workings of the right-wing Liberal faction at the centre of NSW ICAC's Operation Rosny.

daily.title: Crime gangs use bots to lure young men in sextortion scams
daily.summary: Criminal gangs continue to have Australian men and boys in their sights as targets for sexual extortion, with more than $200,000 defrauded from victims in one state.

daily.title: Scientists optimistic despite losing 14,000 tagged bogong moths
daily.summary: Scientists tagged thousands of bogong moths using paper and eyelash glue in an attempt to track their flight path. Now they cannot find a single one.

daily.title: Council tries regulating smart glasses but experts say it needs a heavier touch
daily.summary: Brisbane City Council banned the use of smart glasses at public pools, but experts say the issue is beyond the power of local councils.

daily.title: Lagging fire response in outer Melbourne poses 'risk to community safety'
daily.summary: Residents in growth areas of Melbourne are experiencing worsening responses to fire emergencies, an ABC analysis of Fire Rescue Victoria data has found.

daily.title: 300-plus homes stalled as SA Water battles 'severe constraints'

daily.title: Young dad turns to music to deal with trauma of son's NICU journey
daily.summary: Central Queensland musician Trent Richardson never expected his precious baby boy's delivery would become a medical emergency, or that he would spend months at a Brisbane hospital in the neonatal intensive care unit.

daily.title: How the Panthers and Warriors can win the NRL minor premiership
daily.summary: The NRL minor premiership is still up for grabs heading into the final day of the home-and-away season, with the New Zealand Warriors on top and the Penrith Panthers ready to pounce.

daily.title: Trading 'woke palaces' for 'basic' homes could come with drawbacks

daily.title: Man in Nepal tunnel and woman rescued 10 days after flash flood

daily.title: Mother feared 'failing' baby after months of inconsistent advice postpartum
daily.summary: First-time mother Maddy Barrett was worried she was "starving" her baby when she could not get her newborn to latch properly. She endured months of different advice from multiple practitioners, which left her feeling scared.
